desc:
100 LIKES FOR NEW UPDATE!!

👣 Every step you take makes you BIGGER!
This is a Simulator game, Start tiny in Tiny Town and walk to grow. Outgrow houses, skyscrapers, mountains and clouds, then keep growing until you're stepping over volcanoes and standing next to titans!

🦶 HOW TO PLAY
• Walk to fill your Growth bar and level up. Every level makes you bigger!
• Reach the Level shown on each gate to unlock the next zone
• Stomp small brainrots and smash everything for Coins and combos
• Jump to SLAM the ground and break everything around you
• Get swords and team up to beat the giant zone boss (every 10 minutes!)
• Battle other players: the bigger Level wins
• AFK grow on treadmills in the Giant Gym
• Rebirth to start over with a permanent Growth boost
• Free gifts while you play + daily rewards

🗺️ 10 ZONES
Tiny Town, Brainrot City, Spaghetti Mountains, Cloud Kingdom, Tropic Ocean, Moon Base, Brainrot Dimension, Frostbite Glacier, Inferno Volcano, Titan Island

CAN YOU BE THE BIGGEST
